1

 Hon'Ble Rajiv Lochan Shukla, J. 
1. Heard Sri Ram Jatan Yadav, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Aakash Garg, holding brief
of Sri Ashish Goyal for the opposite party No.2.
2.
Learned counsels for the parties jointly submit that the parties have arrived at a settlement agreement before the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of the Allahabad High Court.
In view of the settlement arrived at, they have amicably settled their dispute and now, no grievance remains and the proceedings may be quashed on the basis of the agreement, so executed.

3. Pursuant to the settlement agreement arrived at between the parties, an amount of Rs.6,50,000/-
has also been paid to the opposite party No.2.
The rest would be paid according to the settlement agreement executed between the parties.
4. Sri Garg states that he has no objection if the proceedings are quashed on the basis of the settlement agreement executed between the parties.

5. In view of the settlement agreement executed between the parties and the part payment of the settled amount having been made to the opposite party No.2, no useful purpose would be served in keeping the proceedings pending before this Court.
The continuation of proceedings would amount to abuse of the process of law.

6. In the result, this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is allowed in terms of the settlement agreement dated 26.09.2025.
7.

The entire proceedings of Complaint Case No.19478 of 2023 (Komal Gola vs. Vishal Verma and others) under Sections 498A, 323, 506, 406 IPC, Police Station- Shahganj, District Agra, pursuant to summoning order dated 15.07.2024, are hereby quashed.
